review:
Joker's Jewels Hot is a retro 5x3 joker slot with a funky soundtrack. Hot Wilds can pop up and merge with any symbol on the grid, boosting the chance of wins.

A bonus round activates as Hot and Hot Wild symbols collect on the grid. Pragmatic Play's own description mentions both a 5,000x maximum and a larger jackpot figure, so we haven't listed a single max win. The joker is the highest-paying symbol. The RTP is 96.5%. A simple, nostalgic game with one key mechanic.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
